user.title: Connect to the hagent app
user.description: Enter the host, the port and the secret of the hagent app. The app shows them in its set-up information (api/integration).

hassio_confirm.title: hagent app found
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the hagent app on {host}?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the hagent app.
error.protocol: The app uses another link protocol version. Update the integration or the app.

abort.already_configured: This hagent app is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the hagent app.
abort.protocol: The app uses another link protocol version. Update the integration or the app.

invoke.name: Invoke agent
invoke.description: Start an invocation of a hagent agent. Target the agent device or one of its entities.

data.name: Data
data.description: Optional context for the agent, as a mapping.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Return the result as response data. If off, return at once and fire hagent_result later.

on_timeout.name: On timeout
on_timeout.description: cancel: stop the invocation and return an error. continue: finish in the background. The default is cancel for agents with outputs, and continue for other agents.
